nodes.label: Postgres-Wire Client Session
nodes.desc: pgwire conn (conn.go L59) speaks the PostgreSQL wire protocol; pgwire Server.ServeConn (server.go L991) hands each session to the SQL layer.

nodes.label: connExecutor — Session State Machine
nodes.desc: connExecutor struct (conn_executor.go L1609); execStmt (conn_executor_exec.go L123) and execStmtInOpenState (L417) drive statement execution.

nodes.label: Cost-Based Optimizer (opt)
nodes.desc: planner.makeOptimizerPlan (plan_opt.go L298) builds a memo; coster.ComputeCost (coster.go L526) prices alternatives.

nodes.label: Physical Plan
nodes.desc: PhysicalPlan struct (physical_plan.go L125) maps relational operators onto distributed processors.

nodes.label: Processors / Flows (execinfra)
nodes.desc: ProcessorBase (processorsbase.go L345) and flowinfra Flow (flow.go L72) run local and distributed data flows.

nodes.label: Txn — Client Transactions
nodes.desc: Txn struct (txn.go L74); Txn.Send (L1386) and Txn.Commit (L926) route operations through TxnCoordSender.

nodes.label: DistSender — Range Routing
nodes.desc: DistSender (dist_sender.go L726); DistSender.Send (L1310) splits BatchRequests by range and sendToReplicas (L2669) picks the leaseholder.

nodes.label: Node — KV RPC Front Door
nodes.desc: Node struct (node.go L366); batchInternal (node.go L1648) receives KVBatch RPCs from any node.

nodes.label: Store — Ranges & Replicas
nodes.desc: Store struct (store.go L909) owns replicas; Store.SendWithWorkStats (store_send.go L101) routes batches to the local replica.

nodes.label: Replica — Leaseholder / Follower
nodes.desc: Replica struct (replica.go L365) evaluates batches for one key range with MVCC and lease checks.

nodes.label: Raft Consensus
nodes.desc: evalAndPropose (replica_raft.go L116), propose (L411), handleRaftReady (L867) replicate commands via pkg/raft (raft.go L305).

nodes.label: Pebble LSM Store
nodes.desc: Pebble struct (pebble.go L884) implements the Engine interface (pkg/storage/engine.go L932): MVCCGet/MVCCPut (mvcc.go L1401/L1923) over an LSM tree.
